dct_title_s: Roads & Transportation Routes (Digital Map Database of China)
dct_description_sm: Abstract: The Roads and Transportation layer describes roads and other related features within China represented by lines and annotation. Super highways, main and secondary roads, trails, horse-cart roads, bridges and roads under construction are included.

Purpose: This transportation data layer documents the principal road and transportation routes that provide the infrastructure for urban and rural development throughout China. It is essential to illustrate and analyze the regional and temporal aspects of human-induced land transformations. Applications, such as the exploration of the development of transportation routes and networks and its correlation to key urban growth processes, will be of use to urban and regional planners, policy and decision-makers, earth scientists, and global change researchers. These data are intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and to provide users with geographic data for cartographic, environmental monitoring, management and impact analysis, economic analysis and other types of geographic analysis. These data can be used with geographic information systems (GIS) software to display and analyze information, or to provide a basemap to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data.
